name: Pep
bio: The fiery leader of the pack. Loves a tight racing line and a crispy edge.
ability_desc: Fires a fan of six spinning pepperoni slices low along the track, ahead or, while you look back, behind you. Each slice ricochets between the track walls and off anything it hits (spinning out racers, smashing items) and vanishes on its third hit.

name: Basil
bio: Cool, fresh and always calm on the last lap. Never panics in a pack.
ability_desc: The longest ability boost: nothing can hit you while it lasts, and it ignores the slow cheese.

name: Olive
bio: Smooth as olive oil through every corner. A master of the long drift.
ability_desc: Leaves a trail of olive-oil slicks behind. Drops ten slicks, and nothing can touch you while you lay them; drive through one and your wheels get coated: no spin, but you are slowed a lot for 5 seconds.

name: Mozz
bio: Stretchy, sunny and impossible to shake off your bumper.
ability_desc: Wraps the kart in stretchy cheese that blocks every hit for a while, with a quick burst of speed.

name: Chili
bio: Hot-headed and always flat out. Saves nothing for the finish.
ability_desc: A fiery boost that leaves burning flames on the road: anyone who drives into them spins out and catches fire. Nothing can hit you while it burns.

name: Shroom
bio: Small, earthy and sneaky on the shortcuts. Knows every hidden trail.
ability_desc: Grows huge and unstoppable with a small surge forward, and flattens anyone it touches, front, side or back, even if they drive into you. They stay squashed and slow for 3 seconds. You can still steer and drift.

name: Pineapple
bio: Divisive but fearless. Loves big jumps and bigger arguments.
ability_desc: A huge spiky blast that spins out every racer anywhere near you, even in the air. The only hit in the game that goes through shields, ability boosts, Delivery Rush and the blink after a hit.

name: Anchovy
bio: Slippery, salty and fast in a straight line. Swims through traffic.
ability_desc: Launches three anchovies that hunt down the next three racers ahead, or the three behind you if you launch them looking back. They always reach their target, but a well-timed hop dodges one.
